notes.title: New Hidden Shapes!!! Cat Realm
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42951112/ca28736833668b9a9f0392c4ff11da9cbcc5c973.gif[/img]

Hey guys!!!

We have news!!!

Now you can have fun assembling the puzzles of the newest game in the Hidden series, [b]Hidden Shapes Cat Realm!![/b]

In this new game in the series you will have fun following the adventure of a fearless kitten to save the princess from the clutches of a dragon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42951112/38beb9079e6c3f00b5783771c7d63917c2964083.gif[/img]

Be amazed by the beautiful art and animations as you complete the puzzle, all prepared to increase the immersion of this beautiful hand-drawn game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42951112/b3e7d81343d75f31b542072420f22c33be9d6efe.gif[/img]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/jACf6GeGBE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42045586/3a42819716a4c33bf1daabb886d523ea2df55680.png[/img] [/url][url=https://www.instagram.com/yaw_studios/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42045586/11f9813a99cf745289ea53768d02395eed8f7de5.png[/img] [/url][url=https://twitter.com/YawStudios][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42045586/dfde44a9c820c63af6d6f242368c558828ff56d7.png[/img] [/url][url=https://www.tiktok.com/@yawstudios?lang=en][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42045586/d0a8dda4af3ac4939f58e29c8fc534f4fa7e620f.png[/img] [/url]

Don't forget to follow us on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/YAWStudios?l=brazilian]Steam page[/url] so you'll know about new games and news from the studio.

[b]We hope you have a lot of fun with the game it was made with great care!!![/b]
